name: patient_has_participated_in_study_nct02786667
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient has participated in the study of non-motor aspects in de novo Parkinson's disease (Honeymoon) (ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT02786667).
when_true: Set to true if the patient has participated in the study of non-motor aspects in de novo Parkinson's disease (Honeymoon) (ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT02786667).
when_false: Set to false if the patient has not participated in the study of non-motor aspects in de novo Parkinson's disease (Honeymoon) (ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT02786667).
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient has participated in the study of non-motor aspects in de novo Parkinson's disease (Honeymoon) (ClinicalTrials.gov Identifier: NCT02786667).

name: patient_is_receiving_dopaminergic_treatment_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is currently receiving dopaminergic treatment.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently receiving dopaminergic treatment.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is not currently receiving dopaminergic treatment.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient is currently receiving dopaminergic treatment.

name: duration_of_stable_dopaminergic_treatment_in_months
meaning: Numeric value indicating the duration, in months, for which the patient has been on stable dopaminergic treatment.
when_unknown: Set to null if the duration of stable dopaminergic treatment is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
when_value: Set to the number of months the patient has been on stable dopaminergic treatment.

name: patient_has_diagnosis_other_than_parkinson_s_disease_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has any diagnosis other than Parkinson's Disease.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has any diagnosis other than Parkinson's Disease.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have any diagnosis other than Parkinson's Disease (i.e., has only Parkinson's Disease or no diagnosis at all).
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has any diagnosis other than Parkinson's Disease.

name: mattis_dementia_rating_scale_total_score_value_recorded_most_recent_withunit_points
meaning: Numeric value representing the most recent Mattis Dementia Rating Scale total score for the patient, in points.
when_unknown: Set to null if the Mattis Dementia Rating Scale total score is not available, not documented, or cannot be determined for the patient.
when_value: Set to the most recent recorded total score value on the Mattis Dementia Rating Scale for the patient, in points.

name: patient_has_diagnosis_of_dementia_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of dementia.
when_true: Set to true if the patient currently has a diagnosis of dementia.
when_false: Set to false if the patient currently does not have a diagnosis of dementia.
when_unknown: Set to null if it is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined whether the patient currently has a diagnosis of dementia.

name: patient_is_pregnant_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is currently pregnant.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently pregnant.
when_false: Set to false if the patient is currently known not to be pregnant.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's current pregnancy status is unknown or cannot be determined.

name: patient_is_parturient_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is currently a parturient woman (in labor or actively delivering a baby).
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently a parturient woman (in labor or actively delivering a baby).
when_false: Set to false if the patient is not currently a parturient woman.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's parturient status is unknown or cannot be determined.

name: mattis_score_value_recorded_most_recently_withunit_points
meaning: Numeric value representing the most recently recorded Mattis score for the patient, in points.
when_unknown: Set to null if the Mattis score is not available, not documented, or cannot be determined for the patient.
when_value: Set to the most recently recorded Mattis score value in points for the patient.

name: patient_is_postpartum_now
meaning: Boolean indicating whether the patient is currently in the postpartum period (recently delivered a baby).
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently in the postpartum period (recently delivered a baby).
when_false: Set to false if the patient is not currently in the postpartum period.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's postpartum status is unknown or cannot be determined.

name: patient_is_protected_by_law_now
meaning: Boolean value indicating whether the patient is currently protected by law.
when_true: Set to true if the patient is currently protected by law (e.g., due to pregnancy, postpartum status, or other legal protections).
when_false: Set to false if the patient is not currently protected by law.
when_unknown: Set to null if the patient's legal protection status is unknown, not documented, or cannot be determined.
